title: The Scimitar Stance Primer
summary: Sets out the grip and guard stance of the broad curved sword with the first cuts for complete beginners.

title: A Beginner's Book of Curved Cuts
summary: Walks new students through the basic cuts and returns of the scimitar one angle at a time.

title: Scimitar Handling for New Recruits
summary: Teaches recruits to carry the scimitar and cut or guard with the broad belly of the blade.

title: The Broad Blade Drill Book
summary: Lists the paired drills that harden wrist and forearm for sweeping scimitar work at close quarters.

title: Plain Lessons in Wrist and Arc
summary: Trains the wrist roll that carries the scimitar through a full arc for students with hardened bone.

title: The Scimitar Workbook
summary: Pairs the first scimitar cuts with the lightest circulation of qi for students newly awakened.

title: A Plain Guide to the Swelling Edge
summary: Explains how the widening belly of the scimitar carries a cut and how to guide it with light qi.

title: Mounted and Afoot Scimitar Basics
summary: Shows the same few scimitar cuts from a saddle and from the ground with a trace of qi.

title: The Curved Blade Foundation Course
summary: A graded course of stance and cut and parry for the broad curved sword with light qi use.

title: Handbook of the Scimitar Tip
summary: Gives the short stabbing and hooking work of the scimitar point to students who already circulate qi.

title: First Principles of the Broad Curve
summary: States the few rules of balance and timing behind every scimitar cut for qi-circulating beginners.
